entries.en: MCP: Support multiple config files with `--mcp-config file1.json file2.json`
entries.zh: MCP：支持通过 `--mcp-config file1.json file2.json` 指定多个配置文件

entries.en: MCP: Press Esc to cancel OAuth authentication flows
entries.zh: MCP：按 Esc 可以取消 OAuth 认证流程

entries.en: Linux: Added support for Alpine and musl-based distributions (requires separate ripgrep installation)
entries.zh: Linux：新增对 Alpine 和基于 musl 的发行版的支持（需单独安装 ripgrep）

entries.en: Bash: Improved command validation and reduced false security warnings
entries.zh: Bash：改进命令验证并减少错误安全警告

entries.en: UI: Enhanced spinner animations and status line visual hierarchy
entries.zh: 界面：增强了加载动画效果和状态栏的视觉层级
